Reply with ONLY the note names expressed in Scientific Pitch Notation, separated by spaces (e.g. C4 E4 G#4). Nothing else. Output only the answer.
results.prompt_doremi: You will hear 5 musical notes played one after another, each separated by a brief silence. Identify all 5 solfège syllable and accidentals (if needed) in order from first to last (fixed-do: do=C re=D mi=E fa=F sol=G la=A si=B; include sharps e.g. do# re#). Reply with ONLY the syllable and accidentals (if needed) separated by spaces (e.g. do mi sol#). Nothing else. Output only the answer.
results.prompt_hz: You will hear 5 musical notes played one after another, each separated by a brief silence. Identify the main pitch frequency, the one that characterizes the note, in Hertz of all 5 notes in order from first to last. Reply with ONLY the frequencies in Hz separated by spaces (e.g. 261.6 329.6 392.0). Nothing else. Output only the answer.
